tongxinRemoteConfig.observed: The latest Test account Tongxin remote-config turn reached auth/bootstrap configuration but the assistant asked the user to provide bootstrap_url and bootstrap_sha256.
tongxinRemoteConfig.rootCause: Tongxin auto_configure still preferred local/bootstrap URL fields before treating configured remote auth as the primary path.
tongxinRemoteConfig.fix: auto_configure now prefers remote auth/bootstrap when auth_url or remote arguments exist, and returns remote_auth_required with username/password nextAction instead of bootstrap_not_configured.

deliveryNoise.observed: A completed artifact-delivery turn appended factory/onboarding questions about naming and communication style after the actual task result.
deliveryNoise.rootCause: The bootstrap prompt asked the model to append personalization questions even when the first turn was a concrete task.
deliveryNoise.fix: Bootstrap now suppresses onboarding questions during concrete tasks, and delivery-task style rules require compact outcome/path/verification/next-step replies.

permissionModes: WebUI exposes only smart-ask as 默认权限 and full-access as 完全访问权限.
Legacy read-only, always-ask and custom modes are normalized to smart-ask on Web load while backend compatibility remains available for existing tests and hidden migrations.
fullAccessRuntime: ToolExecutionEnvironment follows full-access permission mode and opt-in env/config flags to expose system PATH, Node/npx, Python and shell dependencies.
Web service env markers now include ECOREX_INSTALL_ROOT and INSTALL_ROOT so production service runs are not mistaken for isolated unit tests.
Permission broker treats Web event emitters as interactive, preventing default-deny when the Web stream can display a permission request.
tongxinRemoteFirst: Tongxin CLI default client event key is v0.2.5.
auto_configure prefers remote authenticated bootstrap and asks for username/password when credentials are missing.
local xin_agent_cli.py remains an explicit fallback only.
dependencies: install-capability.py now tries the primary PyPI index before fallback indexes.
production host now has system node/npm/npx installed from the OS package manager for full-access Web service runs.
releaseNotes: common/ecorex_release_notes.py and deploy/ecorex-site/manifest.json include default/full-access permission modes, system Node/npx/Python access, Tongxin remote auth/bootstrap and compact delivery replies.
